responsibility: This source file is the compilation unit for GCC's incremental hashing facility. In this revision it primarily exists to provide a standalone object and include context for the inchash interface and any out-of-line hashing support selected by build mode, distinguishing generator builds from normal compiler builds.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/inchash.h, this .cc file provides only the separate compilation unit and build-context includes for the incremental hashing facility, with the hashing API and inline logic living in the header.
